data.name: Fall Asleep
data.detailed_description:
■ Story: A girl’s wish is to wake from the nightmare. A dive into the abyss to grant that wish.

Waking up in the darkness, a girl is greeted by a strange, yet strangely adorable, guide.

"Hey there. You have a wish you want granted, don't you?" "If you reach the bed at the very bottom, that dream will become reality."

Believing those words, the girl throws herself into the endless, deep hole. All for the sake of granting her one "true wish."

■ System: Thrilling Physics-Based Action

This title is a 3D physics-based action game centered on "falling and evading." Players control the girl as she continues her descent, skillfully dodging obstacles that shift according to physics and "Nightmare Phantasms" that block her path.

  • Dynamic Descent: Experience an ever-changing sense of gravity and speed. Enjoy pulse-pounding evasion action.

  • A Beautifully Eerie World: What first appears to be a sublime fantasy space gradually reveals its true form the deeper you go.

  • Diverse Gameplay via Physics: Collision detection and object movements are calculated in real-time, creating a unique sense of tension in every playthrough.

■ The Truth: What Awaits at the Bottom

When she finally lies upon the bed at the abyss's floor, the girl’s wish will be granted. However, once the true nature of that wish is revealed, the story will show a completely different face.

As she heads toward her chosen conclusion... If you happen to grasp "a certain possibility" during the journey, a different future—shrouded in dazzling light—may very rarely visit you.

——Fall, evade, dream, and pray to wake.

The nightmare journey of a girl’s wish begins now.

data.short_description: The girl’s only wish: to wake. "Reach the bed below, and any wish will be granted." Led by a cryptic guide, she leaps into the abyss. Experience immersive, 3D physics-based falling action. Navigate shifting routes and encroaching phantoms. Salvation, or—? Enjoy your wonderful nightmare.
